searchLog: 8th straight day of the same infrastructure failure. Tested 8 domains today: api.ashbyhq.com, boards-api.greenhouse.io, boards.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.lever.co, sierra.ai, www.databricks.com, www.metacareers.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io/xai, and www.google.com as a non-job-board control — all EGRESS_BLOCKED by the network proxy. Only www.anthropic.com resolves; its aggregate /careers/jobs listing loaded and shows Applied AI Architect (53 reqs across 8 teams: Partnerships, Commercial, Cyber, Enterprise Tech, Industries, Public Sector, Startups, Strategic Enterprise Tech), Forward Deployed Engineer (4 reqs), and TPM (24 reqs) — but every individual job-description URL either 404s on anthropic.com directly or redirects to the blocked Greenhouse board, so no specific role's deadline, eligibility, or real application URL could be verified. Commercial, Startups, and Enterprise Tech Applied AI Architect were already sent in the past week (2026-09-25/27 and earlier) and would be duplicates regardless. WebSearch works (does not route through the blocked proxy) and surfaced a live Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad (2027 Start)' posting (SF/Mountain View/Bellevue, wants 'graduating Fall 2026 or Spring 2027' — worth flagging to Dom re: his Dec-2026 date once fetchable) plus the usual target-company leads, but per the verification rule none can be included without loading the real application page, which fetch cannot reach for any non-anthropic.com domain. Zero verified opportunities is the correct, honest output given zero fetchable application pages today — not a quality judgment on the target-company list, which still has strong untested candidates (Mistral, Meta SIL/RPM, Microsoft Aspire, Harvey, Ramp, Cursor, Together AI) queued for whenever egress is restored. This has now failed identically for at least 8 consecutive logged runs (2026-09-22 through 2026-09-29) with an allowlist of effectively one domain. This is a proxy-configuration problem that needs a human fix (widen the egress allowlist to job-board domains: *.greenhouse.io, *.ashbyhq.com, *.lever.co, and target companies' own careers domains), not something a retry or a different search strategy can work around.
